append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1618). updatePractice no longer takes the main Pillar from key order: keepPrimary (lib/practices/split.ts, rule 5) keeps the declared primary (the patch's domain_id, else the row's) while it is still one of the Focuses and falls back to the first key of the map as handed only when the primary left the set; cleanFocusDetails picks no primary; the row's Pillar columns are read once for the Focus clause and the split. The comments in lib/practices.ts, lib/practices/split.ts (withSecondary), lib/studio/entities/practice.ts, app/(main)/practices/create-actions.ts and the builder now say the primary is domain_id. lib/practices-primary-pillar.test.ts drives the real updatePractice with every Focus map in every key order (edit one Focus, add one, a named primary, a split whose secondary sorts first) and 4 of its 8 cases fail against the old rule. Stored rows whose primary already moved: not measured (no database read); a moved primary is still a valid Focus and a save now keeps whatever the author sets. No migration.
